d:
Can the new BYD Shark beat class-leading Toyota & Ford pick-up trucks around an off-road course?!
The Toyota Hilux & Ford Ranger are two of the most renowned pick-up trucks in the world.
The question is: if you’re in the market for a pick-up, should you look past these established off-road heroes and choose the all-new BYD Shark instead?!
To find out, we’ve brought all three together for a head-to-head series of off-road challenges. So let’s take a closer look at each competitor.
